  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio

  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,

  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""

      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:

              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,

      mock_llm_with_queue,

  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""

              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""

      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:

              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )

  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(

          unique_id=unique_id,

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(

          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )

      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,

  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""

              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

      frontend_di,

      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,

  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""

      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:

  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""

      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  @pytest.mark.parametrize("entry", _POSITIVE_E2E, ids=lambda entry: entry.relative_path)
  @pytest.mark.timeout(300)
  @pytest.mark.usefixtures("file_reader_billing_service")
  async def test_capability_files_read_corpus_file(
      capability_gateway_di,
      frontend_di,
      system_user_id: str,
      unique_id: str,
      mock_llm_with_queue,
      entry: CorpusFile,
  ) -> None:
      """files.read capability на каждом файле корпуса через реальное хранилище."""
      require_s3_configured()
      require_heic_entry_supported(entry.relative_path)
      if entry.uses_vision_llm:
          mock_llm_with_queue([_MOCK_VISION_TEXT])

      raw = require_corpus_bytes(entry)
      file_ref = await store_corpus_in_files_service(
          frontend_di,
          entry,
          unique_id=unique_id,
      )
      assert file_ref.file_id is not None

      registry = capability_gateway_di.capability_registry
      read_kwargs = read_file_kwargs_for_entry(entry, unique_id=unique_id)
      response = await registry.call(
          capability_files_read_request(
              user_id=system_user_id,
              file_id=file_ref.file_id,
              page_end=read_kwargs.page_end,
              vision_prompt=read_kwargs.vision_prompt,
              transcription_company_id=read_kwargs.transcription_company_id,
          )
      )
      assert response.status == "ok"
      body = require_json_object(response.result, "files.read.result")
      assert_file_extract_body(body, entry=entry, file_ref=file_ref, raw=raw)

      @pytest.mark.asyncio
      async def test_upsert_updates_existing(self, push_repository, unique_id):

      @pytest.mark.asyncio
      async def test_list_for_user_returns_that_users_rows(self, push_repository, unique_id):
          """Получение всех подписок пользователя."""
          user_id = f"user_multi_{unique_id}"

          # Создаем 3 подписки
          endpoints = []
          for i in range(3):
              endpoint = f"https://fcm.googleapis.com/multi-{unique_id}-{i}"
              endpoints.append(endpoint)
              await push_repository.upsert_by_endpoint(
                  user_id=user_id,
                  endpoint=endpoint,
                  keys={"p256dh": f"key{i}", "auth": f"auth{i}"},
                  platform=["desktop", "ios", "android"][i]
              )

          # Получаем все подписки
          subscriptions = await push_repository.list_for_user(user_id)

          assert len(subscriptions) == 3

          platforms = {s.platform for s in subscriptions}
          assert platforms == {"desktop", "ios", "android"}

          # Cleanup
          for endpoint in endpoints:
              await push_repository.delete_subscription(user_id, endpoint)

      @patch('core.push.service.webpush')
      async def test_notify_user_sends_push_when_offline(
          self,
          mock_webpush,
          push_repository,
          vapid_keys,
          unique_id
      ):
          """
          notify_user() отправляет push если пользователь не подключен к WebSocket.
          """
          from core.push.service import init_web_push_service
          from core.websocket.publisher import Notification, NotificationType, notify_user

          mock_webpush.return_value = MagicMock(status_code=201)

          # Инициализируем сервис
          init_web_push_service(
              vapid_private_key=vapid_keys["private_key"],
              vapid_public_key=vapid_keys["public_key"],
              vapid_email=vapid_keys["email"]
          )

          user_id = f"user_notify_{unique_id}"
          endpoint = f"https://fcm.googleapis.com/notify-{unique_id}"

          # Создаем подписку
          await push_repository.upsert_by_endpoint(
              user_id=user_id,
              endpoint=endpoint,
              keys={"p256dh": "key", "auth": "auth"},
              platform="desktop"
          )

          # Отправляем уведомление (пользователь offline - нет WebSocket)
          notification = Notification(
              type=NotificationType.SYSTEM,
              title="Test Notification",
              message="This should trigger push",
              service="test"
          )

          await notify_user(user_id, notification)

          # webpush должен быть вызван
          assert mock_webpush.called, "webpush should be called for offline user"

          # Cleanup
          await push_repository.delete_subscription(user_id, endpoint)

  @pytest.mark.asyncio
  async def test_orphan_cleanup_tick_removes_orphan_company_chunks(
      rag_provider_pgvector, unique_id, rag_worker_di
  ) -> None:
      from apps.rag_worker.tasks.maintenance_tasks import rag_cleanup_orphan_company_chunks_tick

      chunk_null = f"orphan_null_{unique_id}"
      chunk_empty = f"orphan_empty_{unique_id}"
      ns = f"ns_orphan_e2e_{unique_id}"
      await _insert_stale_chunk(chunk_id=chunk_null, namespace_id=ns,
                                company_id=None, content="null")
      await _insert_stale_chunk(chunk_id=chunk_empty, namespace_id=ns,
                                company_id="", content="empty")

      # Cleanup глобальный: чужой параллельный batch может удалить наши строки
      # раньше нас (deleted нашего тика тогда < 2). Сходимость собственных строк.

          result = await rag_cleanup_orphan_company_chunks_tick(
              schedule_task_id=f"orph_{unique_id}",
              di=rag_worker_di,
          )
          assert result["skipped"] is False
          _, _, exists_null = await _chunk_state(chunk_null)
          _, _, exists_empty = await _chunk_state(chunk_empty)
          if not exists_null and not exists_empty:
              break

      _, _, exists_null = await _chunk_state(chunk_null)
      _, _, exists_empty = await _chunk_state(chunk_empty)
      assert exists_null is False
      assert exists_empty is False
